name: Echo of Amelyssan
backstory:
In life, Amelyssan was once the high priestess of Bhaal. Before his death, Bhaal charged Amelyssan with the ritual needed to bring him back to life. When Bhaal perished in the Time of Troubles, Amelyssan sought to complete her task, not for her fallen god but for herself, as she had later discovered that the divine essence of the slain Bhaalspawn would flow through her, increasing her power.

In her new guise as Melyssan, she sought to gather the Bhaalspawn by presenting herself as their kind protector. In secret, however, she convinced five powerful Bhaalspawn Abazigal a blue dragon, a human monk, Illasera an elven fighter, Sendai a drow cleric, and a fire giant to unite and help her resurrect Bhaal with the promise that Bhaal would make them his right hand and they would rule as demigods.

The Five unleashed their armies upon the Sword Coast killing Bhaalspawn and innocents alike in their path. Those Bhaalspawn that managed to escape the massacre were guided by Amelyssan to the city of in , but the city was encircled by Yaga Shura and his army. In Saradush, Amelyssan met Gorion's Ward, the famous Bhaalspawn that had defeated Sarevok Anchev. She then began using Gorion's Ward as a tool to achieve her goal. She tricked them into meeting the ruler of Saradush who was also a Bhaalspawn which resulted in the latter's death and sent them to an old abandoned Bhaal temple where Yaga-Shura was raised, to discover a way to remove Yaga-Shura's invulnerability. Gorion's Ward succeeded in their task but returned too late, as Saradush and its inhabitants fell to the invading army due to Amelyssan having opened the way for Yaga-Shura. Gorion's Ward and their allies fought the fire giant and managed to put an end to him.

After Yaga-Shura's death, Amelyssan convinced them to deal with the rest of the Five and revealed the locations of Abazigal and Sendai, telling them to use the village of as their base of operations. She told them to seek her ally Balthazar, the ruler of Amkethran, for additional aid, who unbeknownst to Gorion's Ward was the the final member of the Five.

While Gorion's Ward was away dealing with Abazigal and Sendai, Amelyssan approached Balthazar in his monastery, but the monk turned on her and tried to capture her, though she escaped. Gorion's Ward returned to Amkethran to deal with Balthazar at his monastery after they had learned that he was the last member of the Five.
